$\begin{gathered} 2 ( x^{2 } + 8 x ) + 35 & = 2 [ ( x + 4 )^{2} - 16 ] + 25 \end{gathered}$

$\begin{gathered} 2 x^{2} + 16 x + 35 & = 2 [ ( x + 4 )^{2} - 16 ] + 35 \\ = 2 ( x + 4 )^{2} - 32 + 35 \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

$\begin{gathered} = 2 ( x + 4 )^{2} + 3 \end{gathered}$

$\begin{gathered} a & = 2 , b = 4 , c = 3 \end{gathered}$ **[1]**

parts.problem_md: Express $3x^{2}--6x+5$  in the form $a(x--b)^{2}+c$
parts.solution_md:
**Method 1**

> *To complete the square, start by taking a factor of 3 out of the first two terms*

$3 x^{2} - 6 x + 5 = 3 ( x^{2} - 2 x ) + 5$

**[M1]**

> *Then complete the square on the function in the brackets*

- *Halve the coefficient of  *$x$* for the constant inside the curved brackets*
- *and subtract that value squared*

$3 [ ( x - 1 )^{2} - 1^{2} ] + 5$

**[M1]**

> *Expand the square brackets and simplify*

$= 3 ( x - 1 )^{2} - 3 + 5
= 3 ( x - 1 )^{2} + 2$

> *That's in the form required, with *$a=3$*, *$b=1$* and *$c=2$

$3 ( x - 1 )^{2} + 2$

**[A1]**

**Method 2**

> *You could expand the *$a(x--b)^{2}+c$* and compare coefficients*

$\begin{gathered} a ( x - b )^{2} + c & = a ( x^{2} - 2 b x + b^{2} ) + c \\ = a x^{2} - 2 a b x + a b^{2} + c \end{gathered}$

**[M1]**

> *Set that equal to the original quadratic*

$3x^{2}-6x+5=ax^{2}-2abx+ab^{2}+c$

> *Comparing coefficients*

$a=3$

$\begin{gathered} - 2 a b & = - 6 \\ - 2 \times 3 \times b & = - 6 \\ b = 1 \end{gathered}$

$\begin{gathered} a b^{2} + c & = 5 \\ 3 \times 1^{2} + c & = 5 \\ c + 3 & = 5 \\ c = 2 \end{gathered}$

**[M1]**

$3 ( x - 1 )^{2} + 2$

**[A1]**
